# Overview

**Extended** HT1080 LOY-vs-sgCTRL analysis — robustness layer on top of the
canonical base report (`2.2.1_rnaseq_HT1080_base.Rmd`). Same count matrix,
same samples, additional sanity-checks and alternative framings designed to
answer "would the conclusions change if we'd made different statistical
choices?".

Every DE-centric section now covers **three contrast designs side-by-side**
where appropriate, so the choice of baseline (sgCTRL paired by passage,
sgCTRL unpaired, or PARENTAL + sgCTRL pooled as Y+) is itself a robustness
axis rather than a hidden assumption.

**Counts pipeline.** Counts come from `STAR_v2_PARfix/AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY/`
— a PAR-Y-masked STAR realignment + featureCounts re-quantification done
specifically to recover chrX-PAR reads that the original AUG_2025 STAR run
silently dropped at multi-mapper filtering. MSY (true chrY) counts are
unchanged; PAR1/PAR2 counts (SHOX, CSF2RA, SLC25A6, etc.) are now non-zero.
Y-region annotation lives in §1.4.5; the Y/PAR-retaining volcano is §4.0;
the §11 LOY-transcriptomics summary now produces real PAR signature scores.

1. **Filter-threshold sensitivity** (§2). Sweep `MIN_COUNT ∈ {50, 100, 200}`
   on the paired design (the design of record), report DEG and Hallmark NES
   concordance across thresholds, pick the threshold used downstream. The
   design-choice axis (paired / unpaired / pooled) is addressed in §4/§5/§6
   and the §10 robustness summary, where it actually shapes the result.
2. **voom diagnostics + sample weights** (§3). Mean-variance plot and
   `voomWithQualityWeights` for sample-reliability auditing on 3v3 data
   (paired, design-of-record).
3. **Effect-size-aware DE with `treat()`** (§4). Tested against the lfc
   threshold across all 3 designs.
4. **edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check** (§5). `glmQLFTest` as a second
   statistical framework across all 3 designs.
5. **`camera` gene-set testing** (§6). Competitive, correlation-aware
   side-by-side with fgsea, across all 3 designs.
6. **Sex-chromosome homologs / Y-linked paralog deep-dive** (§7). KDM5D/C,
   UTY/KDM6A, DDX3Y/X, RPS4Y1/X, EIF1AY/X, ZFY/X, TMSB4Y/X, USP9Y/X, PRKY/X,
   NLGN4Y/X — dosage compensation analysis (paired, design-independent at
   the per-sample level).
7. **Sample-level pathway scoring** (§8). GSVA / ssGSEA Hallmark, PROGENy,
   decoupleR-PROGENy, and custom LOY/PRC2/chrY signatures. Sample scoring
   is design-independent; the LM significance test at the end is run across
   all 3 designs.
8. **lpWGS copy-number integration** (§9). Gene-level CN from HT1080
   QDNAseq on T2T-CHM13, DEG annotation (canonical paired), chromosome-arm
   shifts, CN-flagged DEG sensitivity rerun across all 3 designs in §9.9,
   Y-loss confirmation panel (lpWGS + RNA).
9. **Robustness summary** (§10). Combined DEG table across all statistical
   pipelines × all designs + CN + paralog flags; "confident DEG" call.

Notation: HT1080 = NRAS Q61K fibrosarcoma; CTRL = sgRNA non-targeting control
(Y+); LOY = Y-chromosome–targeting sgRNA (Y−); PARENTAL retained for QC and
the **pooled** Y+ baseline (LOY vs PARENTAL + sgCTRL).

## 1.2 Paths and figure helper

```{r define-paths}
# --- Data root ---------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream pipeline outputs (featureCounts tables, lpWGS QDNAseq RDS) live
# on the local Dropbox tree. Update this single line if data moves.
DATA_ROOT  <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects"
# STAR_v2_PARfix tables — PAR-Y-masked realignment so chrX PAR genes (SHOX,
# CSF2RA, SLC25A6, etc.) actually have reads. The previous AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY/
# tables silently dropped PAR multi-mappers (~0 reads on every PAR1 gene).
COUNTS_DIR <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "RNAseq", "counts",
                        "STAR_v2_PARfix", "AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY")

# --- Output paths ------------------------------------------------------
# All outputs namespaced under HT1080/ inside this analysis directory so
# A549/LNCaP outputs don't collide. CSVs/RDSes are gitignored repo-wide;
# PNG/PDF figures under figures_LOY_sgCTRL_extended/ are tracked.

CELL_DIR    <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "HT1080")

FIG_DIR     <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "figures_LOY_sgCTRL_extended")
SCORES_DIR  <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "PATHWAY_SCORES")
CN_DEG_DIR  <- file.path(CELL_DIR, "CN_DEG")

for (d in c(DE_DIR, FIG_DIR, SCORES_DIR, CN_DEG_DIR)) {

}

ALPHA   <- 0.05
LFC_THR <- 0.75

save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)  [%gx%g in]\n", name, width, height))

}
```

## 1.3 Sample metadata + counts

```{r build-samples}
count_files <- list.files(COUNTS_DIR,
                          pattern = "^HT1080.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
count_files <- count_files[!grepl("\\.summary$", count_files)]
stopifnot(length(count_files) == 9)

samples <- data.frame(
  sample_id = sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(count_files)),
  cell_line = "HT1080",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = case_when(
      grepl("-LOY-",      sample_id) ~ "LOY",
      grepl("-CTRL-",     sample_id) ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("-PARENTAL-", sample_id) ~ "PARENTAL",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    replicate = sub(".*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", sample_id),
    y_status  = ifelse(treatment == "LOY", "Y-", "Y+")
  )
stopifnot(!any(is.na(samples$treatment)))

samples %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            replicates = paste(sort(replicate), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "HT1080 Sample Summary (n=9)")
```

```{r load-counts}
genes <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) %>% as.data.frame()

df_list <- lapply(count_files, function(f) {
  df <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE, header = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(1, 7)
  names(df) <- c("geneID", sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(f)))
  column_to_rownames(df, var = "geneID")
})
count_matrix <- do.call("cbind", df_list)
count_matrix <- count_matrix[grepl("^ENSG", rownames(count_matrix)), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_matrix), samples$sample_id))

cat("Loaded", nrow(count_matrix), "genes across",
    ncol(count_matrix), "samples\n")
```

## 1.4 Build DGEList scaffold (no filtering yet)

```{r dge-scaffold}
treatment <- factor(samples$treatment, levels = c("PARENTAL", "CTRL", "LOY"))
passage   <- factor(samples$replicate, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))

dge0 <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix, group = treatment)
dge0$samples$treatment <- treatment
dge0$samples$passage   <- passage

gene_ids_full  <- rownames(dge0$counts)
gene_ids_clean <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_ids_full)
gene_info <- genes[match(gene_ids_clean, genes$gene_id), ]
gene_info$gene_id <- ifelse(is.na(gene_info$gene_id),
                            gene_ids_clean, gene_info$gene_id)
rownames(gene_info) <- gene_ids_full
dge0$genes <- gene_info

keep_ann <- !is.na(dge0$genes$gene_name) & !is.na(dge0$genes$entrezid)
dge0 <- dge0[keep_ann, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes with full annotation:", nrow(dge0), "\n")

```

## 1.4.5 Y-region annotation (PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY-Yp / MSY-Yq)

GRCh38 PAR coordinates (Ensembl/GENCODE). PAR genes are annotated on chrX
only (chrY PAR positions are masked at the annotation level), so PAR
identification scans chrX. MSY = remaining chrY genes (non-PAR), split into
Yp / Yq by the chrY centromere midpoint (~10.43 Mb, UCSC).

Two filter sets are exposed downstream:

- **`chrY_gene_ids`** (MSY only) — stripped from the DGEList before
  differential expression (§2 filter sweep, §4 treat-helpers). PAR genes
  stay so they get logFC + FDR like every other gene in §4.1+ volcanos.
- **`excluded_gene_ids`** (chrY ∪ PAR) — stripped at every pathway-input
  boundary: `prep_ranks()` in the sweep chunk; camera voom rows in §6;
  ssGSEA / PROGENy / decoupleR lcpm matrices in §8; CN-sensitivity rerun
  in §9.9 (via `prep_ranks`). Camera/GSVA/decoupleR are gene-set / TF
  tests where PAR LOY signal would distort the result (it's library-
  composition artefact, not biology).

```{r y-region-annotation}
PAR1_X_START <- 10001L;       PAR1_X_END   <- 2781479L
PAR2_X_START <- 155701383L;   PAR2_X_END   <- 156030895L
Y_CENTROMERE_MID <- 10430000L

y_panel <- dge0$genes %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id_ver") %>%
  mutate(ensembl_id = gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", ensembl_id_ver)) %>%
  mutate(region = case_when(
    seqnames == "X" & start >= PAR1_X_START & end <= PAR1_X_END ~ "PAR1",
    seqnames == "X" & start >= PAR2_X_START & end <= PAR2_X_END ~ "PAR2",
    seqnames == "Y" & end   <= Y_CENTROMERE_MID                 ~ "MSY-Yp",
    seqnames == "Y" & start >= Y_CENTROMERE_MID                 ~ "MSY-Yq",
    TRUE                                                         ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(region))

par_gene_ids        <- y_panel$ensembl_id[y_panel$region %in% c("PAR1", "PAR2")]
chrY_gene_ids       <- y_panel$ensembl_id[y_panel$region %in% c("MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")]
excluded_gene_ids   <- unique(c(chrY_gene_ids, par_gene_ids))

# gene-symbol versions for filtering symbol-keyed pathway inputs
par_gene_names      <- y_panel$gene_name[y_panel$region %in% c("PAR1", "PAR2")]
chrY_gene_names     <- y_panel$gene_name[y_panel$region %in% c("MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")]
excluded_gene_names <- unique(c(chrY_gene_names, par_gene_names))

cat(sprintf(
  "Y-region panel: %d genes  [PAR1=%d, PAR2=%d, MSY-Yp=%d, MSY-Yq=%d]\n",
  nrow(y_panel),
  sum(y_panel$region == "PAR1"),
  sum(y_panel$region == "PAR2"),
  sum(y_panel$region == "MSY-Yp"),
  sum(y_panel$region == "MSY-Yq")))
cat(sprintf("Exclusion set for pathway analyses: %d genes (chrY ∪ PAR)\n",
            length(excluded_gene_ids)))

# 4-colour palette for Y-region categories (Okabe-Ito-derived)
y_region_cols <- c(
  "PAR1"   = "#0072B2",   # blue
  "PAR2"   = "#56B4E9",   # light blue
  "MSY-Yp" = "#D55E00",   # red
  "MSY-Yq" = "#E69F00")   # orange
```

## 1.5 Multi-design DE infrastructure

The robustness sections (§2 filter sweep, §4 treat, §5 edgeR-QL, §6 camera,
§8.6 LM tests, §9.9 CN-flagged rerun, §10 robustness summary) all run the
same three DE designs side-by-side. Defining the design specifications once
keeps the downstream code mechanical.

```{r design-specs}
# A "design spec" is everything needed to fit a DE model for a given contrast
# given a starting DGEList: how to subset samples, how to build the design
# matrix, and the contrast name. Each spec is a list with:
#   label       : short tag for filenames/tabs
#   subset      : function(samples) -> logical vector of samples to keep
#   make_design : function(meta) -> design matrix (colnames are factor levels
#                                                  e.g. "CTRL"/"LOY"/"Y_NEG"/"Y_POS")
#   contrast    : string contrast (must reference colnames of make_design)
DESIGN_SPECS <- list(
  paired = list(
    label       = "paired",
    title       = "Paired (treatment + passage block)",
    subset      = function(m) m$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY"),
    make_design = function(m) {
      m$treatment <- factor(m$treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY"))
      m$passage   <- droplevels(m$passage)
      des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage, data = m)
      # Strip only the "treatment" prefix so the contrast "LOY - CTRL"
      # resolves. Leave "passage<N>" intact — bare digits would not be
      # syntactically valid R names and makeContrasts would refuse them.
      colnames(des) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(des))
      des
    },
    contrast    = "LOY - CTRL"),
  unpaired = list(
    label       = "unpaired",
    title       = "Unpaired (treatment only)",
    subset      = function(m) m$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY"),
    make_design = function(m) {
      m$treatment <- factor(m$treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY"))
      des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment, data = m)
      colnames(des) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(des))
      des
    },
    contrast    = "LOY - CTRL"),
  pooled = list(
    label       = "pooled",
    title       = "Pooled Y+ (PARENTAL + sgCTRL vs LOY)",
    subset      = function(m) m$treatment %in% c("PARENTAL", "CTRL", "LOY"),
    make_design = function(m) {
      m$y_pool <- factor(
        ifelse(m$treatment == "LOY", "Y_NEG", "Y_POS"),
        levels = c("Y_POS", "Y_NEG"))
      des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + y_pool, data = m)
      colnames(des) <- gsub("^y_pool", "", colnames(des))
      des
    },
    contrast    = "Y_NEG - Y_POS"))

# Fit one DE model from a DGEList + design spec; returns a list with the
# voom object, the lmFit/eBayes fit, the design matrix, the subset DGEList,
# and the topTable (all annotated to gene symbols / FDR / etc.).
fit_de_design <- function(dge_in, spec, do_voom = TRUE) {
  m <- dge_in$samples
  keep <- spec$subset(m)
  d <- dge_in[, keep, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  d$samples$treatment <- droplevels(d$samples$treatment)
  d$samples$passage   <- droplevels(d$samples$passage)
  d <- calcNormFactors(d, method = "TMM")
  des <- spec$make_design(d$samples)
  cm  <- makeContrasts(contrasts = spec$contrast, levels = colnames(des))
  v <- if (do_voom) voom(d, des, plot = FALSE) else NULL
  fit <- if (do_voom) {
    lmFit(v, des) %>% contrasts.fit(cm) %>% eBayes()
  } else NULL
  tt <- if (!is.null(fit)) {
    tb <- topTable(fit, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P")
    tb$gene_name <- d$genes[rownames(tb), "gene_name"]
    tb$FDR       <- tb$adj.P.Val
    tb$PValue    <- tb$P.Value
    tb
  } else NULL
  list(spec = spec, dge = d, design = des, voom = v, fit = fit, top = tt)
}

cat(sprintf("Design specs registered: %s\n",
            paste(names(DESIGN_SPECS), collapse = ", ")))
```

***

# 2. Filter-threshold sensitivity sweep

`filterByExpr(min.total.count = ?)` with `MIN_COUNT ∈ {50, 100, 200}`. For each,
build the LOY+CTRL working set, refit paired limma–voom DE, capture DEG counts,
and run fgsea on Hallmark.

```{r filter-sweep}
build_dge_lc <- function(dge_full, min_count) {
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge_full, group = dge_full$samples$treatment,
                       min.total.count = min_count)
  dge_f <- dge_full[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  # Strip chrY (MSY) only — PAR genes stay in the DGEList so they get
  # logFC/FDR in §4 DE. PAR is filtered out at pathway-input boundaries
  # (prep_ranks below, camera/GSVA/etc. in later sections).
  strip_idx <- which(
    gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(dge_f$counts)) %in% chrY_gene_ids)
  if (length(strip_idx) > 0) dge_f <- dge_f[-strip_idx, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge_f <- dge_f[, dge_f$samples$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")]
  dge_f$samples$treatment <- droplevels(dge_f$samples$treatment)
  dge_f$samples$passage   <- droplevels(dge_f$samples$passage)
  calcNormFactors(dge_f, method = "TMM")
}

run_de_paired <- function(dge_lc) {
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage,
                         data = dge_lc$samples)
  colnames(design) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(design))
  cm  <- makeContrasts("LOY - CTRL", levels = colnames(design))
  v   <- voom(dge_lc, design, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design) %>%
    contrasts.fit(cm) %>%
    eBayes()
  list(
    design = design, cm = cm, v = v, fit = fit,
    de = topTable(fit, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
      dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val, logCPM = AveExpr)
  )
}

cat("Loading Hallmark for sweep...\n")
hall_msig <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
hall_paths <- split(hall_msig$gene_symbol, hall_msig$gs_name)

prep_ranks <- function(de) {
  # Drops PAR genes (par_gene_names from §1.4.5) so fgsea + downstream
  # pathway calls see PAR-clean ranks. PAR LOY signal would otherwise
  # distort the leading-edge for any Hallmark set that contains PAR genes.
  r <- de %>%
    transmute(gene = gene_name, stat = t) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), is.finite(stat),
                  !gene %in% par_gene_names) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(stat = stat[which.max(abs(stat))], .groups = "drop")
  ribo <- grep("^RPS\\d|^RPL\\d", r$gene)
  if (length(ribo) > 0) r <- r[-ribo, ]
  setNames(r$stat, r$gene) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE)
}

sweep_thresholds <- c(50, 100, 200)
sweep_results <- lapply(sweep_thresholds, function(mc) {
  cat(sprintf("\n--- MIN_COUNT = %d ---\n", mc))
  dge_lc_i <- build_dge_lc(dge0, mc)
  cat(sprintf("  After filter: %d genes; %d samples\n",
              nrow(dge_lc_i), ncol(dge_lc_i)))
  de_obj   <- run_de_paired(dge_lc_i)
  de_i     <- de_obj$de
  set.seed(42)
  gsea_i   <- suppressWarnings(fgsea(hall_paths, prep_ranks(de_i),
                                     minSize = 15, maxSize = 500))
  list(
    min_count = mc, dge_lc = dge_lc_i, de_obj = de_obj,
    de = de_i, gsea = gsea_i,
    n_tested = nrow(de_i),
    n_sig    = sum(de_i$FDR < ALPHA),
    n_sig_lfc = sum(de_i$FDR < ALPHA & abs(de_i$logFC) > LFC_THR)
  )
})
names(sweep_results) <- paste0("mc", sweep_thresholds)
```

## 2.1 Summary table

```{r sweep-summary}
sweep_tbl <- tibble(
  MIN_COUNT  = sweep_thresholds,
  n_tested   = sapply(sweep_results, `[[`, "n_tested"),
  n_FDR_0.05 = sapply(sweep_results, `[[`, "n_sig"),
  `n_FDR_0.05_&_|lfc|>0.75` = sapply(sweep_results, `[[`, "n_sig_lfc"),
  n_hallmark_padj_0.05 = sapply(sweep_results, function(s)
    sum(s$gsea$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
)
knitr::kable(sweep_tbl,
             caption = "Filter-threshold sweep — tested genes, DEGs, GSEA hits")
```

## 2.2 Gene-set overlap across thresholds

```{r sweep-overlap, fig.height=5, fig.width=11}
deg_sets <- lapply(sweep_results, function(s) {
  s$de %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA) %>% pull(gene_name) %>% unique()
})
tested_sets <- lapply(sweep_results, function(s) rownames(s$de_obj$v))

venn_df <- function(set_list, title) {
  all_g <- unique(unlist(set_list))
  if (length(all_g) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() +
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                      label = paste0(title, "\n(empty — no genes)"),
                      size = 4) +
             theme_void())
  }
  m <- vapply(set_list, function(s) all_g %in% s,
              FUN.VALUE = logical(length(all_g)))
  if (!is.matrix(m)) m <- matrix(m, nrow = length(all_g),
                                 dimnames = list(NULL, names(set_list)))
  rownames(m) <- all_g
  m_df <- as.data.frame(m) %>%
    mutate(combo = apply(m, 1, function(x)
      paste(names(set_list)[x], collapse = " ∩ "))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(combo != "") %>%
    dplyr::count(combo, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(-n)
  ggplot(m_df, aes(x = reorder(combo, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Gene count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
}

p_sweep_tested <- venn_df(tested_sets, "Tested-gene overlap (post filter)")
p_sweep_deg    <- venn_df(deg_sets,    "DEG overlap (FDR<0.05)")
p_sweep <- p_sweep_tested + p_sweep_deg
print(p_sweep)
save_fig(p_sweep, "sweep_overlap", width = 11, height = 5)
```

## 2.3 Hallmark NES concordance across thresholds

```{r sweep-gsea-concord, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
nes_wide <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sweep_results), function(i) {
  sweep_results[[i]]$gsea %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES) %>%
    mutate(min_count = sweep_thresholds[i])
})) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = min_count, names_prefix = "mc",
              values_from = NES)

cor_50_100  <- cor(nes_wide$mc50,  nes_wide$mc100,
                   use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
cor_50_200  <- cor(nes_wide$mc50,  nes_wide$mc200,
                   use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(title = sprintf("ρ = %.3f", cor_50_100),
       x = "NES (MIN_COUNT=50)", y = "NES (MIN_COUNT=100)") +

p2 <- ggplot(nes_wide, aes(mc50, mc200)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +

  labs(title = sprintf("ρ = %.3f", cor_50_200),

p3 <- ggplot(nes_wide, aes(mc100, mc200)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
```

# 4. Effect-size-aware DE with `treat()`

`treat()` tests `|logFC| > LFC_THR` instead of `≠ 0`. This is what the
post-hoc filter in the canonical report tried to approximate, but treat does
it inside the test — giving correct p-values for the effect-size question.
Run side-by-side on all three designs (paired / unpaired / pooled) so the
choice of baseline is itself a robustness axis.

```{r treat-helpers}
# Reusable volcano helper — used for treat (§4), edgeR-QL (§5), and any
# design-tabset DE downstream. Takes a DE data.frame with gene_name + logFC
# + PValue + FDR; returns a ggplot.
make_volcano_ext <- function(de_df, title, x_lab = NULL,
                             pval_col = "PValue", fdr_col = "FDR",
                             n_label = 40) {
  d <- de_df %>%
    mutate(nlp = -log10(pmax(.data[[pval_col]], 1e-300)),
           sig = .data[[fdr_col]] < ALPHA,
           direction = case_when(
             sig & logFC >  LFC_THR ~ "Up in LOY",
             sig & logFC < -LFC_THR ~ "Down in LOY",
             TRUE                   ~ "NS"
           ),
           direction = factor(direction,
                              levels = c("Down in LOY", "NS", "Up in LOY")))
  n_up   <- sum(d$direction == "Up in LOY")
  n_down <- sum(d$direction == "Down in LOY")
  top    <- d %>% dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
    slice_min(.data[[pval_col]], n = n_label)
  cols   <- c("Down in LOY" = "#0072B2", "NS" = "grey80",
              "Up in LOY"   = "#D55E00")
  ggplot(d, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LFC_THR, LFC_THR), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top, aes(label = gene_name),
                    size = 2.7, fontface = "italic",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.4, force = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(d$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
             y = max(d$nlp,   na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
             label = paste0("n = ", n_up),
             color = "#D55E00", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    annotate("text",
             x = min(d$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
             y = max(d$nlp,   na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
             label = paste0("n = ", n_down),
             color = "#0072B2", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    labs(x = x_lab %||% expression(log[2]~"Fold Change"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
         title = title, color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12))
}

# Run treat() against each design spec.
run_treat_for_designs <- function(dge_in, specs) {
  out <- lapply(specs, function(sp) {
    fit_obj <- fit_de_design(dge_in, sp, do_voom = TRUE)
    if (is.null(fit_obj$fit)) return(NULL)
    fit_t <- treat(fit_obj$fit, lfc = LFC_THR)
    tt <- topTreat(fit_t, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P")
    tt$gene_name <- fit_obj$dge$genes[rownames(tt), "gene_name"]
    tt$FDR    <- tt$adj.P.Val
    tt$PValue <- tt$P.Value
    list(fit_obj = fit_obj, fit_treat = fit_t, top = tt)
  })
  out
}

treat_results <- run_treat_for_designs(dge0_full <- {
  # Rebuild a single full DGEList at the picked MIN_COUNT, keeping PARENTAL
  # available for the pooled design. (build_dge_lc subset to CTRL+LOY only.)
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge0, group = dge0$samples$treatment,
                       min.total.count = PICKED_MC)
  dgef <- dge0[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  # Strip chrY (MSY) only — PAR genes stay for DE (filtered at pathway entries).
  strip_idx <- which(
    gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(dgef$counts)) %in% chrY_gene_ids)
  if (length(strip_idx) > 0) dgef <- dgef[-strip_idx, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  calcNormFactors(dgef, method = "TMM")
}, DESIGN_SPECS)

# Per-design counts + save
treat_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(treat_results), function(nm) {
  r <- treat_results[[nm]]
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  tt <- r$top
  fwrite(tt, file.path(DE_DIR,
         sprintf("ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_treat_%s.csv", nm)))
  tibble(
    design = nm,
    n_FDR_0.05            = sum(tt$FDR < ALPHA, na.rm = TRUE),
    `n_FDR_0.05_up`       = sum(tt$FDR < ALPHA & tt$logFC >  LFC_THR, na.rm = TRUE),
    `n_FDR_0.05_down`     = sum(tt$FDR < ALPHA & tt$logFC < -LFC_THR, na.rm = TRUE))
}))
knitr::kable(treat_summary, digits = 0,
             caption = "treat() — sig DEG counts by design (HT1080)")

# Canonical paired treat result aliased for §10 robustness summary
de_treat <- treat_results$paired$top
```

## 4.0 Y-region volcano (pre-strip)

A LOY-vs-sgCTRL paired DE run on a **Y-retaining and PAR-retaining** working
set (mirror of `dge0_full` above but skips the `excluded_gene_ids` strip).
Every chrY (MSY-Yp / MSY-Yq) and chrX-PAR (PAR1 / PAR2) gene that passes
filterByExpr appears with a real `logFC` + `FDR` value — so the volcano
shows what the LOY perturbation does to the Y-linked + PAR expression
landscape before §4.1+ strips those genes for downstream pathway analysis.

This view was previously impossible because the upstream STAR pipeline
dropped PAR multi-mappers (all PAR genes had ~0 reads). Now that
`STAR_v2_PARfix` counts are loaded (see §1.2), PAR genes have real values.

```{r y-region-de-extended}
# Y-retaining working set: same MIN_COUNT filter + CTRL+LOY subset + TMM as
# the §4 paired path, but no excluded_gene_ids strip.
keep_yret <- filterByExpr(dge0, group = dge0$samples$treatment,
                          min.total.count = PICKED_MC)
dge_y_ret <- dge0[keep_yret, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_y_ret <- dge_y_ret[, dge_y_ret$samples$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")]
dge_y_ret$samples$treatment <- droplevels(dge_y_ret$samples$treatment)
dge_y_ret$samples$passage   <- droplevels(dge_y_ret$samples$passage)
dge_y_ret <- calcNormFactors(dge_y_ret, method = "TMM")

design_y_ret <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage,
                             data = dge_y_ret$samples)
colnames(design_y_ret) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(design_y_ret))
cm_y_ret <- makeContrasts("LOY - CTRL", levels = colnames(design_y_ret))
v_y_ret   <- voom(dge_y_ret, design_y_ret, plot = FALSE)
fit_y_ret <- lmFit(v_y_ret, design_y_ret) %>%
  contrasts.fit(cm_y_ret) %>%
  eBayes()
de_y_ret <- topTable(fit_y_ret, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val, logCPM = AveExpr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id_ver") %>%
  mutate(ensembl_id = gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", ensembl_id_ver)) %>%
  left_join(y_panel %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_id, region),
            by = "ensembl_id") %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region,
                         levels = c("PAR1", "PAR2", "MSY-Yp", "MSY-Yq")))

cat(sprintf("Y-retaining paired DE: %d genes tested\n", nrow(de_y_ret)))
cat(sprintf("  Y-region genes: %d  [PAR1=%d, PAR2=%d, MSY-Yp=%d, MSY-Yq=%d]\n",
            sum(!is.na(de_y_ret$region)),
            sum(de_y_ret$region == "PAR1",   na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(de_y_ret$region == "PAR2",   na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(de_y_ret$region == "MSY-Yp", na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(de_y_ret$region == "MSY-Yq", na.rm = TRUE)))

fwrite(de_y_ret %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
         dplyr::select(ensembl_id, gene_name, region,
                       logFC, PValue, FDR, logCPM),
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_yregion.csv"))
```

```{r y-region-volcano-extended, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
y_region_volcano <- function(de_df, title, n_label = 25) {
  bg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(region)) %>%
    mutate(nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)))
  fg <- de_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
    mutate(nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)))
  lab <- fg %>% group_by(region) %>%
    slice_max(abs(logFC), n = n_label, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = bg, aes(logFC, nlp),
               color = "grey85", alpha = 0.4, size = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LFC_THR, LFC_THR), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = fg, aes(logFC, nlp, color = region),
               size = 2.4, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = lab, aes(logFC, nlp, label = gene_name, color = region),
      size = 3.1, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = Inf,
      segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.4, force = 2,
      show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = y_region_cols, drop = FALSE,
                       name = "Y region") +
    labs(x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
         title = title,
         subtitle = "Paired contrast on Y/PAR-retaining DGEList; grey = non-Y/non-PAR background") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13))
}

p_y_vol <- y_region_volcano(
  de_y_ret,
  "HT1080: LOY vs sgCTRL — Y region (PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY-Yp / MSY-Yq)")
print(p_y_vol)
save_fig(p_y_vol, "volcano_LOY_v_sgCTRL_yregion", width = 8, height = 6)
```

## 4.3 Cross-design DEG overlap (treat)

How much of the canonical paired-treat DEG set is recovered by the unpaired
and pooled designs? Strong overlap means the LOY effect is reproducible
across baseline choice.

```{r treat-cross-design-overlap, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
sets_by_design <- lapply(treat_results, function(r)
  r$top %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA) %>% pull(gene_name) %>% unique())

cross_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sets_by_design), function(nm) {
  s <- sets_by_design[[nm]]
  vs_paired <- list(
    only_this  = setdiff(s, sets_by_design$paired),
    both       = intersect(s, sets_by_design$paired),
    only_paired = setdiff(sets_by_design$paired, s))
  tibble(design = nm,
         this_only          = length(vs_paired$only_this),
         both_vs_paired     = length(vs_paired$both),
         paired_only_vs_this = length(vs_paired$only_paired))
}))
knitr::kable(cross_df,
             caption = "treat() DEG overlap with paired (anchor) — per design")
```

# 5. edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check

Second statistical framework on each of the three designs — voom/limma's
gaussian-on-logCPM vs edgeR's negative-binomial-with-QL. Convergent signal
across both frameworks for the same design is the strongest evidence that
the LOY effect is real.

```{r edger-ql-run}
run_edger_ql_for_designs <- function(treat_res) {
  out <- lapply(treat_res, function(r) {
    if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    d    <- r$fit_obj$dge
    des  <- r$fit_obj$design
    spec <- r$fit_obj$spec
    cm_l <- makeContrasts(contrasts = spec$contrast, levels = colnames(des))
    dq <- estimateDisp(d, des, robust = TRUE)
    fq <- glmQLFit(dq, des, robust = TRUE)
    ql <- glmQLFTest(fq, contrast = cm_l)
    tt <- topTags(ql, n = Inf)$table
    tt$gene_id_full <- rownames(tt)
    tt$gene_name <- d$genes$gene_name[
      match(rownames(tt), rownames(d$genes))]
    tt$PValue <- tt$PValue %||% tt$P.Value  # edgeR returns PValue already
    list(dge_q = dq, fit_q = fq, top = tibble::as_tibble(tt))
  })
  out
}

ql_results <- run_edger_ql_for_designs(treat_results)

ql_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ql_results), function(nm) {
  r <- ql_results[[nm]]
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  fwrite(r$top, file.path(DE_DIR,
         sprintf("ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_edgeRQL_%s.csv", nm)))
  tibble(
    design = nm,
    n_FDR_0.05            = sum(r$top$FDR < ALPHA, na.rm = TRUE),
    `n_FDR_0.05_&_lfc>thr` = sum(r$top$FDR < ALPHA & abs(r$top$logFC) > LFC_THR,
                                 na.rm = TRUE))
}))
knitr::kable(ql_summary, digits = 0,
             caption = "edgeR-QL sig DEG counts by design (HT1080)")
```

## 5.2 QL t-stat concordance with voom (by design) {.tabset}

```{r ql-voom-concord-helper}
ql_voom_concord_plot <- function(treat_res, ql_top, design_label) {
  voom_de <- treat_res$fit_obj$top
  ql_signed <- ql_top %>%
    mutate(stat_ql = sign(logFC) * sqrt(F)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC_ql = logFC, stat_ql, FDR_ql = FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name))
  cmp <- inner_join(
    voom_de %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, t, FDR),
    ql_signed, by = "gene_name",
    suffix = c("", "_ql"))
  rho <- cor(cmp$t, cmp$stat_ql, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  rlf <- cor(cmp$logFC, cmp$logFC_ql, use = "complete.obs")
  p1 <- ggplot(cmp, aes(logFC, logFC_ql)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = sprintf("logFC voom vs QL — r = %.3f", rlf),
         x = "voom logFC", y = "edgeR QL logFC") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
  p2 <- ggplot(cmp, aes(t, stat_ql)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = sprintf("Signed stat — Spearman ρ = %.3f", rho),
         x = "voom t", y = "edgeR sign(lfc)*sqrt(F)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
  p <- p1 + p2 + patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("HT1080 — voom vs QL (%s)", design_label))
  list(plot = p, rho = rho, rlf = rlf)
}
```

# 6. `camera` gene-set testing

`camera` is a competitive gene-set test that accounts for inter-gene
correlation — a complement to the (rank-based, correlation-naive) fgsea
results in the canonical report's §5.

```{r camera-prep}
cat("Loading MSigDB collections for camera...\n")
collections_cam <- list(
  hallmark = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"),
  cgp      = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CGP"),
  cp_react = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")
)
pathways_cam <- lapply(collections_cam,
                       function(x) split(x$gene_symbol, x$gs_name))

# Map row IDs (Ensembl) to symbols and index for camera
sym_by_row <- dge_lc$genes$gene_name
names(sym_by_row) <- rownames(v_basic)
```

```{r camera-run}
run_camera_for_design <- function(treat_res, pathways_list, design_label) {
  v   <- treat_res$fit_obj$voom
  des <- treat_res$fit_obj$design
  cm_l <- makeContrasts(contrasts = treat_res$fit_obj$spec$contrast,
                        levels = colnames(des))

  # Drop PAR rows from voom before camera — camera is a gene-set test and
  # PAR LOY signal here is library-composition artefact, not pathway biology.
  sym_by_row <- treat_res$fit_obj$dge$genes$gene_name
  names(sym_by_row) <- rownames(v)
  par_rows <- which(sym_by_row %in% par_gene_names)
  if (length(par_rows) > 0) {
    v <- v[-par_rows, ]
    sym_by_row <- sym_by_row[-par_rows]
  }

  do_one <- function(pathways, coll_label) {
    idx <- ids2indices(pathways, sym_by_row)
    res <- camera(v, index = idx, design = des, contrast = cm_l)
    res %>%
      rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
      mutate(collection = coll_label, design = design_label) %>%
      arrange(FDR)
  }

  list(
    hall = do_one(pathways_list$hallmark, "hallmark"),
    cgp  = do_one(pathways_list$cgp,      "cgp"),
    rea  = do_one(pathways_list$cp_react, "cp_reactome"))
}

camera_results <- lapply(names(treat_results), function(nm) {
  run_camera_for_design(treat_results[[nm]], pathways_cam, nm)
})
names(camera_results) <- names(treat_results)

# Save combined per-design CSV
for (nm in names(camera_results)) {
  fwrite(bind_rows(camera_results[[nm]]),
         file.path(DE_DIR,
                   sprintf("ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_camera_%s.csv", nm)))
}

# Cross-design × collection summary
cam_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(camera_results), function(nm) {
  r <- camera_results[[nm]]
  tibble(
    design       = nm,
    hallmark_sig = sum(r$hall$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    cgp_sig      = sum(r$cgp$FDR  < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    reactome_sig = sum(r$rea$FDR  < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))
}))
knitr::kable(cam_summary,
             caption = "camera FDR<0.05 hits by design × collection (HT1080)")
```

## 6.1 camera vs fgsea: Hallmark side-by-side (by design) {.tabset}

```{r camera-vs-fgsea-helper}
camera_vs_fgsea <- function(treat_res, cam_hall_design) {
  set.seed(42)
  voom_de <- treat_res$fit_obj$top
  fgsea_h <- suppressWarnings(
    fgsea(pathways_cam$hallmark, prep_ranks(voom_de),
          minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj_fgsea = padj)
  cam_hall_design %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, camera_Dir = Direction,
                  camera_FDR = FDR, camera_PValue = PValue) %>%
    left_join(fgsea_h, by = "pathway") %>%
    mutate(agree = case_when(
      is.na(NES) ~ NA_character_,
      NES > 0 & camera_Dir == "Up"   ~ "agree Up",
      NES < 0 & camera_Dir == "Down" ~ "agree Down",
      TRUE                            ~ "disagree")) %>%
    arrange(camera_FDR)
}
```

```{r camera-fgsea-paired}
            sum(cmp_p$agree %in% c("agree Up", "agree Down"), na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(!is.na(cmp_p$agree))))
```

## 6.2 camera Hallmark dotplot (by design) {.tabset}

```{r camera-dotplot-helper}
camera_dotplot <- function(cam_hall, design_label) {
  cam_dot <- cam_hall %>%
    slice_min(FDR, n = 25) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Down", "Up")),
      pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway) %>%
                        gsub("_", " ", .) %>% str_to_title() %>% str_wrap(40),
      nlp = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-50)),
      signed_nlp = ifelse(Direction == "Up", nlp, -nlp),
      pathway_label = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, signed_nlp))
  ggplot(cam_dot, aes(x = signed_nlp, y = pathway_label,
                      size = nlp, fill = signed_nlp)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0,
                         name = expression("signed " * -log[10](FDR))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6),
                          name = expression(-log[10](FDR))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    labs(x = expression("signed " * -log[10] * "(camera FDR)"), y = NULL,
         title = sprintf("camera — Top 25 Hallmark sets · %s",
                         design_label),
         subtitle = "← Down in LOY      Up in LOY →") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5))
}
```

# 7. Sex-chromosome homologs / Y-linked paralog deep-dive

```{r paralog-pairs-def}
paralog_pairs <- tribble(
  ~Y,        ~X,
  "KDM5D",   "KDM5C",
  "UTY",     "KDM6A",
  "DDX3Y",   "DDX3X",
  "RPS4Y1",  "RPS4X",
  "EIF1AY",  "EIF1AX",
  "ZFY",     "ZFX",
  "TMSB4Y",  "TMSB4X",
  "USP9Y",   "USP9X",
  "PRKY",    "PRKX",
  "NLGN4Y",  "NLGN4X"
)
paralog_genes <- c(paralog_pairs$Y, paralog_pairs$X)

# Pull expression on a full DGEList that retains Y-chromosome genes for §7;
# use the same MIN_COUNT filter but keep CTRL+LOY+Y, drop only PARENTAL.
dge_full_no_yfilter <- dge0
keep_full <- filterByExpr(dge_full_no_yfilter,
                          group = dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$treatment,
                          min.total.count = PICKED_MC)
dge_full_no_yfilter <- dge_full_no_yfilter[keep_full, ,
                                           keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_full_no_yfilter <- dge_full_no_yfilter[, dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")]
dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$treatment <- droplevels(
  dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$treatment)
dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$passage <- droplevels(
  dge_full_no_yfilter$samples$passage)
dge_full_no_yfilter <- calcNormFactors(dge_full_no_yfilter, method = "TMM")

design_par <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage,
                           data = dge_full_no_yfilter$samples)
colnames(design_par) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(design_par))
cm_par <- makeContrasts("LOY - CTRL", levels = colnames(design_par))
v_par <- voom(dge_full_no_yfilter, design_par, plot = FALSE)
fit_par <- lmFit(v_par, design_par) %>%
  contrasts.fit(cm_par) %>% eBayes()
de_par <- topTable(fit_par, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val, logCPM = AveExpr)

lcpm_par <- cpm(dge_full_no_yfilter, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
rownames(lcpm_par) <- dge_full_no_yfilter$genes$gene_name
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(lcpm_par))) {
  rv_p <- matrixStats::rowVars(lcpm_par)
  lcpm_par <- lcpm_par[order(-rv_p), , drop = FALSE]
  lcpm_par <- lcpm_par[!duplicated(rownames(lcpm_par)), , drop = FALSE]
}

paralog_present <- intersect(paralog_genes, rownames(lcpm_par))
paralog_missing <- setdiff(paralog_genes, rownames(lcpm_par))
cat(sprintf("Paralog genes detected: %d / %d\n",
            length(paralog_present), length(paralog_genes)))
if (length(paralog_missing) > 0) {
  cat("Missing (filtered out or unannotated): ",
      paste(paralog_missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

## 7.1 Per-pair boxplots

```{r paralog-boxplots, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
para_df <- lcpm_par[paralog_present, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  left_join(
    dge_full_no_yfilter$samples %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, treatment, passage),
    by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY")),
    pair_id = sapply(gene, function(g) {
      hit <- which(paralog_pairs$Y == g | paralog_pairs$X == g)
      if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_
      else paste0(paralog_pairs$Y[hit], " / ", paralog_pairs$X[hit])
    }),
    chromosome = ifelse(gene %in% paralog_pairs$Y, "Y", "X"),
    pair_id = factor(pair_id, levels = paste0(paralog_pairs$Y, " / ",
                                              paralog_pairs$X))
  )

para_ann <- de_par %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% paralog_present) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene = gene_name, logFC, FDR) %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("lfc %.2f\nFDR %.2g", logFC, FDR))

p_para_box <- ggplot(para_df,
                     aes(x = treatment, y = logCPM, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = passage), size = 2,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, seed = 1)) +
  geom_text(data = para_df %>%
              left_join(para_ann, by = "gene") %>%
              distinct(gene, pair_id, chromosome, lab),
            aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.5,
            color = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ pair_id + chromosome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5,
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#009E73", "LOY" = "#E69F00"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = passage_shapes, name = "Passage") +
  labs(title = "HT1080 — X/Y paralog pairs",
       subtitle = "logCPM per sample; paired DE lfc / FDR per gene",
       x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"(CPM)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

print(p_para_box)
save_fig(p_para_box, "paralog_boxplots", width = 12, height = 10)
```

## 7.3 Dosage-compensation index

```{r paralog-compensation}
para_lfc %>%
  mutate(
    compensation_index = X_logFC - (-Y_logFC),
    # = X_logFC + Y_logFC; magnitude near 0 = perfect compensation
    interpretation = case_when(
      Y_logFC < -0.5 & X_logFC >  0.2 ~ "X upregulated (compensating)",
      Y_logFC < -0.5 & abs(X_logFC) < 0.2 ~ "X flat (no compensation)",
      Y_logFC < -0.5 & X_logFC < -0.2 ~ "X also down (co-regulated?)",
      abs(Y_logFC) <= 0.5 ~ "Y not changed",
      TRUE ~ "Y changed (other dir)"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(pair, Y, Y_logFC, Y_FDR, X, X_logFC, X_FDR,
                compensation_index, interpretation) %>%
  arrange(Y_logFC) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3,
               caption = "X/Y paralog dosage-compensation summary")
```

## 7.4 Paralog heatmap {.tabset}

Side-by-side z-scaled logCPM heatmap of the X/Y paralog pairs. The default
LOY-vs-sgCTRL tab matches the rest of §7 (paired contrast working set). The
"with PARENTAL" tab adds the 3 PARENTAL samples as an untreated baseline —
useful for spotting whether any X/Y paralog drift in LOY also appears
between PARENTAL and sgCTRL (a sgRNA artifact rather than LOY biology).

```{r paralog-heatmap-helper}
draw_paralog_heatmap <- function(lcpm_mat, dge_obj, fig_name,
                                 col_title) {
  hm_mat    <- lcpm_mat[paralog_present, , drop = FALSE]
  hm_scaled <- t(scale(t(hm_mat)))

  row_split <- ifelse(rownames(hm_scaled) %in% paralog_pairs$Y, "Y", "X")
  col_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Treatment = dge_obj$samples$treatment,
    Passage   = as.character(dge_obj$samples$passage),
    col = list(Treatment = treatment_cols,
               Passage   = c("1" = "#CCCCCC", "2" = "#888888",
                             "3" = "#444444")),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

  ht_p <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    hm_scaled,
    name = "z(logCPM)",
    col  = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
    cluster_columns = TRUE,
    row_split = row_split,
    top_annotation = col_ann,
    row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_title    = col_title,
    row_title       = NULL,
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey20", lwd = 0.3))

  w <- max(6, 0.5 + ncol(hm_scaled) * 0.55)
  png(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(fig_name, ".png")),
      width = w, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
  draw(ht_p); dev.off()
  pdf(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(fig_name, ".pdf")),
      width = w, height = 6)
  draw(ht_p); dev.off()
  draw(ht_p)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)\n", fig_name))
  invisible(ht_p)
}

# 9-sample paralog working set (PARENTAL + CTRL + LOY) for the second tab.
# Mirror the §7 setup: apply the same MIN_COUNT filter, keep Y genes, but
# DON'T drop PARENTAL. TMM is recomputed on the 9-sample subset so paralog
# logCPMs are on the same scale across treatments.
dge_full_with_par <- dge0
keep_full_par <- filterByExpr(dge_full_with_par,
                              group = dge_full_with_par$samples$treatment,
                              min.total.count = PICKED_MC)
dge_full_with_par <- dge_full_with_par[keep_full_par, ,
                                       keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_full_with_par$samples$treatment <- droplevels(
  dge_full_with_par$samples$treatment)
dge_full_with_par$samples$passage <- droplevels(
  dge_full_with_par$samples$passage)
dge_full_with_par <- calcNormFactors(dge_full_with_par, method = "TMM")

lcpm_par_with_par <- cpm(dge_full_with_par, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
rownames(lcpm_par_with_par) <- dge_full_with_par$genes$gene_name
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(lcpm_par_with_par))) {
  rv2 <- matrixStats::rowVars(lcpm_par_with_par)
  lcpm_par_with_par <- lcpm_par_with_par[order(-rv2), , drop = FALSE]
  lcpm_par_with_par <- lcpm_par_with_par[
    !duplicated(rownames(lcpm_par_with_par)), , drop = FALSE]
}
paralog_present_all <- intersect(paralog_genes, rownames(lcpm_par_with_par))
```

### LOY vs sgCTRL only

```{r paralog-heatmap-loy-ctrl, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
draw_paralog_heatmap(
  lcpm_par, dge_full_no_yfilter,
  fig_name  = "paralog_heatmap",
  col_title = "HT1080 — X/Y paralog scaled expression (LOY + sgCTRL)")
```

### With PARENTAL

```{r paralog-heatmap-with-parental, fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
# Override paralog_present locally so the helper uses the all-sample set
# (in case any paralog was filtered out by the LOY+CTRL-only filter).
old_present <- paralog_present
paralog_present <- paralog_present_all

draw_paralog_heatmap(
  lcpm_par_with_par, dge_full_with_par,
  fig_name  = "paralog_heatmap_with_parental",
  col_title = "HT1080 — X/Y paralog scaled expression (PARENTAL + sgCTRL + LOY)")
```

# 8. Sample-level pathway scoring

Goal: instead of contrast-level enrichment, score each Hallmark / PROGENy /
custom signature per sample, then test the score with the paired model.

```{r scores-mat-setup}
lcpm_lc <- cpm(dge_lc, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
rownames(lcpm_lc) <- dge_lc$genes$gene_name
# Collapse symbol duplicates by max-variance row
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(lcpm_lc))) {
  rv <- matrixStats::rowVars(lcpm_lc)
  ord <- order(-rv)
  lcpm_lc <- lcpm_lc[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  lcpm_lc <- lcpm_lc[!duplicated(rownames(lcpm_lc)), , drop = FALSE]
}

# Drop PAR rows — every §8 pathway-scoring call (ssGSEA / PROGENy /
# decoupleR-PROGENy) consumes lcpm_lc, so filtering once here cascades to
# all of them. PAR LOY signal here is library-composition artefact and
# would distort the sample-level scores for any pathway containing PAR.
lcpm_lc <- lcpm_lc[!rownames(lcpm_lc) %in% par_gene_names, , drop = FALSE]

samples_lc <- dge_lc$samples %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, treatment, passage)
```

## 8.1 GSVA / ssGSEA on Hallmark

```{r gsva-ssgsea}
gsva_par <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(exprData = lcpm_lc,
                              geneSets = pathways_cam$hallmark,
                              minSize  = 5)
gsva_mat <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_par, verbose = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("ssGSEA: %d Hallmark sets x %d samples\n",
            nrow(gsva_mat), ncol(gsva_mat)))

gsva_long <- as.data.frame(gsva_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "sample", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(method = "ssGSEA")
fwrite(as.data.frame(gsva_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("pathway"),
       file.path(SCORES_DIR, "ht1080_gsva_hallmark_scores.csv"))
```

## 8.2 PROGENy pathway activity

```{r progeny-run}
prog_mat <- progeny::progeny(lcpm_lc, scale = TRUE,
                             organism = "Human", top = 500,
                             perm = 1)
prog_mat <- t(prog_mat)  # → pathways x samples
cat(sprintf("PROGENy: %d pathways x %d samples\n",
            nrow(prog_mat), ncol(prog_mat)))

prog_long <- as.data.frame(prog_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "sample", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(method = "PROGENy")
fwrite(as.data.frame(prog_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("pathway"),
       file.path(SCORES_DIR, "ht1080_progeny_scores.csv"))
```

## 8.3 decoupleR-PROGENy (cross-method check)

```{r dc-progeny}
prog_net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "human", top = 500)
dc_prog <- decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = lcpm_lc, net = prog_net,
                              .source = "source", .target = "target",
                              .mor = "weight", minsize = 5)
dc_prog_mat <- dc_prog %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  as.matrix()
cat(sprintf("decoupleR-PROGENy: %d pathways x %d samples\n",
            nrow(dc_prog_mat), ncol(dc_prog_mat)))
```

## 8.4 PROGENy vs decoupleR-PROGENy concordance

```{r prog-vs-dcprog, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5.5}
# Align rows (pathways) and columns (samples) between the two matrices
common_p <- intersect(rownames(prog_mat), rownames(dc_prog_mat))
common_s <- intersect(colnames(prog_mat), colnames(dc_prog_mat))
prog_a <- prog_mat[common_p, common_s]
dc_a   <- dc_prog_mat[common_p, common_s]

prog_flat <- as.vector(prog_a)
dc_flat   <- as.vector(dc_a)
rho <- cor(prog_flat, dc_flat, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

p_prog_cor <- tibble(progeny = prog_flat, decoupleR = dc_flat,
                     pathway = rep(rownames(prog_a), ncol(prog_a))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(progeny, decoupleR)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = pathway), alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(title = sprintf("PROGENy vs decoupleR-PROGENy (Spearman ρ = %.3f)",
                       rho),
       x = "progeny pkg score", y = "decoupleR ulm score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
print(p_prog_cor)
save_fig(p_prog_cor, "progeny_vs_decoupleR_concord",
         width = 5.5, height = 4.5)
```

## 8.5 Custom signatures (LOY / PRC2-bivalent / chrY)

```{r custom-sigs}
# LOY signature: top-50 down-in-LOY genes (excluding chrY) — circular but a
# useful internal-consistency QC against the rest of the report.
loy_sig <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC < -LFC_THR) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = 50) %>% pull(gene_name)

# PRC2 / bivalent
cgp_full <- pathways_cam$cgp
prc2_sig <- unique(c(
  cgp_full[["MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3"]],
  cgp_full[["BENPORATH_PRC2_TARGETS"]],
  cgp_full[["MEISSNER_BRAIN_HCP_WITH_H3K4ME3_AND_H3K27ME3"]]
))
prc2_sig <- prc2_sig[!is.na(prc2_sig)]

# Y-chr coding (sanity — should drop in LOY)
chrY_coding <- genes %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "Y", gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>% unique()

# Two-stage scoring: LOY_down + PRC2 on the Y-stripped matrix (lcpm_lc),
# chrY signature on the Y-retaining matrix (lcpm_par) — then rbind.
auto_sets <- list(
  LOY_down_top50 = intersect(loy_sig,  rownames(lcpm_lc)),
  PRC2_bivalent  = intersect(prc2_sig, rownames(lcpm_lc))
)
auto_sets <- auto_sets[sapply(auto_sets, length) >= 3]

custom_mat_auto <- GSVA::gsva(
  GSVA::ssgseaParam(exprData = lcpm_lc,
                    geneSets = auto_sets, minSize = 3),
  verbose = FALSE)

# chrY (Y-retaining)
chrY_present <- intersect(chrY_coding, rownames(lcpm_par))
chrY_row <- NULL
if (length(chrY_present) >= 3) {
  chrY_score_mat <- GSVA::gsva(
    GSVA::ssgseaParam(exprData = lcpm_par[, colnames(lcpm_lc)],
                      geneSets = list(chrY_coding = chrY_present),
                      minSize = 3),
    verbose = FALSE)
  chrY_row <- chrY_score_mat["chrY_coding", colnames(custom_mat_auto),
                             drop = FALSE]
}

if (is.null(chrY_row)) {
  custom_mat <- custom_mat_auto
  custom_sets <- auto_sets
} else {
  custom_mat <- rbind(custom_mat_auto, chrY_row)
  custom_sets <- c(auto_sets, list(chrY_coding = chrY_present))
}

cat("Custom signature sizes (after gene-matrix filter):\n")
print(sapply(custom_sets, length))

custom_long <- as.data.frame(custom_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "sample", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(method = "ssGSEA_custom")
fwrite(as.data.frame(custom_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("pathway"),
       file.path(SCORES_DIR, "ht1080_custom_signature_scores.csv"))
```

## 8.6 LM test on each score (paired vs unpaired) {.tabset}

Per-pathway score shift tested against treatment. Paired (`~ treatment +
passage`) is the canonical analysis; unpaired (`~ treatment`) is the
robustness comparison — agreement between the two means the passage block
isn't carrying the signal.

Note: a "pooled" LM here would require re-scoring GSVA/PROGENy on the full
9-sample DGEList (CTRL + LOY + PARENTAL). Sample-level scoring above is on
the 6-sample CTRL+LOY working set, so paired/unpaired is the natural pair
of tests at the score level. The DE-level pooled design is tested in §4/§5.

```{r score-lm-helpers}
test_scores_design <- function(score_mat, method_label, design_type) {
  res <- lapply(rownames(score_mat), function(p) {
    s <- score_mat[p, , drop = TRUE]
    df <- samples_lc %>% mutate(score = s[sample])
    form <- if (design_type == "paired") {
      score ~ treatment + passage
    } else {
      score ~ treatment
    }
    f <- tryCatch(lm(form, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
    co <- summary(f)$coefficients
    loy_row <- grep("treatmentLOY", rownames(co), value = TRUE)
    if (length(loy_row) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(pathway = p,
           method  = method_label,
           beta_LOY = co[loy_row, "Estimate"],
           SE       = co[loy_row, "Std. Error"],
           p_value  = co[loy_row, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  })
  bind_rows(res) %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(p_value)
}

score_tests_for <- function(dt) {
  bind_rows(
    test_scores_design(gsva_mat,    "ssGSEA_hallmark",   dt),
    test_scores_design(prog_mat,    "PROGENy",           dt),
    test_scores_design(dc_prog_mat, "decoupleR_PROGENy", dt),
    test_scores_design(custom_mat,  "ssGSEA_custom",     dt))
}
```

### Paired

```{r score-lm-paired}
score_tests_paired <- score_tests_for("paired")
fwrite(score_tests_paired,
       file.path(SCORES_DIR, "ht1080_pathway_score_tests_paired.csv"))
cat("Top 15 sample-level pathway score shifts (paired):\n")
score_tests_paired %>% slice_min(p_value, n = 15) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 3, 3, 4, 4))
```

### Unpaired

```{r score-lm-unpaired}
score_tests_unpaired <- score_tests_for("unpaired")
fwrite(score_tests_unpaired,
       file.path(SCORES_DIR, "ht1080_pathway_score_tests_unpaired.csv"))
cat("Top 15 sample-level pathway score shifts (unpaired):\n")
score_tests_unpaired %>% slice_min(p_value, n = 15) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 3, 3, 4, 4))
```

# 9. lpWGS copy-number integration

**Data**: HT1080 lpWGS (`HT1080-sgCTRL-D0`, `HT1080-LOY-D0` — n=1 per arm,
single timepoint, T2T-CHM13v2.0). Pre-segmented by QDNAseq in
`projects/WGS/code/coverage_report_HT1080_QDNAseq.Rmd`, exported as
`HT1080_QDNAseq_cn.rds` + `HT1080_QDNAseq_cn_df.rds`. The n=1-per-arm
constraint means CN is treated as a **population backdrop** for the RNAseq
contrast — not per-replicate matched.

## 9.1 Load CN object

```{r cn-load}
cn_rds    <- file.path(WGS_RDS_DIR, "HT1080_QDNAseq_cn.rds")
cn_df_rds <- file.path(WGS_RDS_DIR, "HT1080_QDNAseq_cn_df.rds")

if (!file.exists(cn_rds) || !file.exists(cn_df_rds)) {
  stop("CN RDS files not found. Re-knit ",
       "WGS/code/coverage_report_HT1080_QDNAseq.Rmd first.")
}

cn    <- readRDS(cn_rds)
cn_df <- readRDS(cn_df_rds)
cat(sprintf("Loaded CN: %d bins x %d samples (T2T-CHM13)\n",
            length(unique(cn_df$bin_id)),
            length(unique(cn_df$sample))))
print(unique(cn_df$label))
```

## 9.2 Build T2T-CHM13 gene coordinate index

```{r t2t-gene-index, cache=TRUE}
cat("Loading T2T-CHM13v2.0 GTF (may take ~30s)...\n")
gtf_gr <- rtracklayer::import(T2T_GTF)
gene_gr <- gtf_gr[gtf_gr$type == "gene"]

# NCBI RefSeq GTF uses gene_name or gene field
sym_field <- if ("gene" %in% names(mcols(gene_gr))) "gene" else "gene_name"
gene_meta <- tibble(
  gene_symbol = mcols(gene_gr)[[sym_field]],
  seqnames    = as.character(seqnames(gene_gr)),
  start       = start(gene_gr),
  end         = end(gene_gr)
) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_symbol))

# RefSeq seqnames use NC_*; map to chrN using a lookup from the chromosome
# header (chromosome attribute on the entry if present)
chrom_attr <- if ("chromosome" %in% names(mcols(gene_gr))) {
  as.character(mcols(gene_gr)$chromosome)
} else { NA_character_ }
if (!all(is.na(chrom_attr))) {
  gene_meta$chromosome <- paste0("chr", chrom_attr[match(
    gene_meta$gene_symbol, mcols(gene_gr)[[sym_field]])])
} else {
  # Fallback: build from NC_* accession ordering (NC_060925-NC_060948 = 1..Y)
  nc_to_chr <- setNames(
    paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y", "M")),
    sprintf("NC_%06d.1", 60925:60949))
  gene_meta$chromosome <- nc_to_chr[gene_meta$seqnames]
}

gene_meta <- gene_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chromosome)) %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol, chromosome, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("T2T gene index: %d genes across chroms %s\n",
            nrow(gene_meta),
            paste(unique(gene_meta$chromosome), collapse = ",")))
```

## 9.3 Overlap RNA genes onto QDNAseq bins

```{r cn-overlap}
# Build bin GRanges from cn_df
bin_gr <- cn_df %>%
  distinct(bin_id, chromosome, start, end) %>%
  with(GRanges(seqnames = chromosome,
               ranges = IRanges(start = start, end = end),
               bin_id = bin_id))

# Build gene GRanges restricted to symbols present in our DE table
de_symbols <- unique(de_loy_ctrl$gene_name)
gene_match <- gene_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_symbol %in% de_symbols)

gene_grA <- GRanges(seqnames = gene_match$chromosome,
                    ranges = IRanges(start = gene_match$start,
                                     end   = gene_match$end),
                    gene_symbol = gene_match$gene_symbol)
ov <- findOverlaps(gene_grA, bin_gr)

gene_to_bin <- tibble(
  gene_symbol = gene_grA$gene_symbol[queryHits(ov)],
  bin_id      = bin_gr$bin_id[subjectHits(ov)]
)

# Per gene, per sample: pull the segmented log2 value of the overlapping bin.
# If a gene spans multiple bins (rare at 100kb), take the median.
cn_df_use <- cn_df %>%
  mutate(label = as.character(label))

# Pivot CN to wide: bin_id x sample
cn_wide <- cn_df_use %>%
  dplyr::select(bin_id, label, log2_seg) %>%
  distinct(bin_id, label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "bin_id", names_from = "label",
              values_from = "log2_seg")

stopifnot(c("sgCTRL", "LOY") %in% colnames(cn_wide))

gene_cn <- gene_to_bin %>%
  left_join(cn_wide, by = "bin_id") %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    cn_log2_sgCTRL = median(sgCTRL, na.rm = TRUE),
    cn_log2_LOY    = median(LOY,    na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bins         = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cn_delta = cn_log2_LOY - cn_log2_sgCTRL)

cat(sprintf("Genes with CN mapping: %d / %d in DE\n",
            nrow(gene_cn), length(de_symbols)))
fwrite(gene_cn, file.path(CN_DEG_DIR, "ht1080_gene_CN_map.csv"))
```

## 9.4 Annotate DE table with CN

```{r de-cn-annotate}
de_with_cn <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  left_join(gene_cn, by = c("gene_name" = "gene_symbol")) %>%
  mutate(
    # CN-driven flag: sizable CN shift in same direction as expression shift
    cn_driven_flag = !is.na(cn_delta) &
                     abs(cn_delta) > 0.3 &
                     sign(cn_delta) == sign(logFC),
    cn_state_LOY = case_when(
      is.na(cn_log2_LOY)         ~ NA_character_,
      cn_log2_LOY >  0.3         ~ "Gain",
      cn_log2_LOY < -0.3         ~ "Loss",
      TRUE                       ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )
fwrite(de_with_cn, file.path(CN_DEG_DIR, "ht1080_DEG_with_CN.csv"))

cat("DEGs (FDR<0.05) flagged as CN-driven: ",
    sum(de_with_cn$cn_driven_flag & de_with_cn$FDR < ALPHA), " / ",
    sum(de_with_cn$FDR < ALPHA), "\n")
```

## 9.5 DEG volcano colored by CN state — cutoff sweep {.tabset}

The classifier compares each gene's lpWGS `cn_delta = log2(LOY/sgCTRL)` at its
bin to a Gain/Loss cutoff. The sensible range is 0.3–0.5 (0.3 ≈ 1.23× signal
shift, 0.5 ≈ 1.41× shift). Three tabs at 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5; tighter cutoffs
keep only the most confident CN shifts. The 3-across composite is also
saved to disk as `volcano_LOY_v_sgCTRL_cn_cutoff_sweep.(png|pdf)`.

```{r cn-volcano-helper}
cn_cols <- c("Unmapped" = "grey85",
             "Neutral"  = "grey60",
             "Gain"     = "#B2182B",
             "Loss"     = "#2166AC")

make_cn_volcano <- function(cutoff) {
  df <- de_with_cn %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
      cn_state_delta = case_when(
        is.na(cn_delta)      ~ "Unmapped",
        cn_delta >  cutoff   ~ "Gain",
        cn_delta < -cutoff   ~ "Loss",
        TRUE                 ~ "Neutral"
      ),
      cn_state_delta = factor(cn_state_delta,
                              levels = c("Unmapped", "Neutral",
                                         "Gain", "Loss")))

  n_gain <- sum(df$cn_state_delta == "Gain")
  n_loss <- sum(df$cn_state_delta == "Loss")

  lab <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, abs(logFC) > LFC_THR,
                  cn_state_delta %in% c("Gain", "Loss")) %>%
    slice_min(PValue, n = 20)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = nlp, color = cn_state_delta)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cn_state_delta %in%
                                       c("Unmapped", "Neutral")),
               alpha = 0.4, size = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., cn_state_delta %in%
                                       c("Gain", "Loss")),
               alpha = 0.9, size = 1.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LFC_THR, LFC_THR), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene_name),
                    size = 2.4, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = Inf,
                    segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cn_cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = expression(log[2]~"FC (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)"),
         title = sprintf("|cn_delta| > %.1f", cutoff),
         subtitle = sprintf("Gain n=%d  ·  Loss n=%d",
                            n_gain, n_loss)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9))
}
```

### Gene counts by cutoff

```{r cn-volcano-counts}
cutoff_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(cutoffs, function(co) {
  df <- de_with_cn %>%
    mutate(state = case_when(
      is.na(cn_delta)     ~ "Unmapped",
      cn_delta >  co      ~ "Gain",
      cn_delta < -co      ~ "Loss",
      TRUE                ~ "Neutral"))
  tibble(
    cutoff = co,
    Gain   = sum(df$state == "Gain"),
    Loss   = sum(df$state == "Loss"),
    Neutral = sum(df$state == "Neutral"),
    Unmapped = sum(df$state == "Unmapped"),
    Gain_among_sig   = sum(df$state == "Gain" & df$FDR < ALPHA &
                             abs(df$logFC) > LFC_THR),
    Loss_among_sig   = sum(df$state == "Loss" & df$FDR < ALPHA &
                             abs(df$logFC) > LFC_THR))
}))
knitr::kable(cutoff_counts,
             caption = "Gene counts by cn_delta cutoff (Gain_among_sig / Loss_among_sig restricted to FDR<0.05 & |logFC|>0.75)")
```

## 9.6 Chromosome-arm mean shifts

```{r cn-arm-shifts, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# Crude p/q split: bin midpoint vs chrom midpoint (T2T centromeres differ
# from hg38; this is an approximation good enough for "arms cluster?")
arm_assign <- cn_df %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(arm = ifelse(midpoint < median(range(midpoint)), "p", "q")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(bin_id, chromosome, arm)

gene_arm <- gene_to_bin %>%
  left_join(arm_assign, by = "bin_id") %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(chromosome = dplyr::first(chromosome),
            arm = paste0(dplyr::first(chromosome),
                         dplyr::first(arm)),
            .groups = "drop")

arm_summary <- de_with_cn %>%
  left_join(gene_arm, by = c("gene_name" = "gene_symbol")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(arm)) %>%
  group_by(arm) %>%
  summarise(mean_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_cn_delta = mean(cn_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_genes = n(),
            chromosome = dplyr::first(chromosome),
            .groups = "drop")

arm_force_cooccur <- c("chr22p", "chr6p", "chr8q", "chr13p")

arm_summary <- arm_summary %>%
  mutate(co_occurs = (abs(mean_logFC) > 0.1 &
                      sign(mean_logFC) == sign(mean_cn_delta) &
                      abs(mean_cn_delta) > 0.1) |
                     arm %in% arm_force_cooccur)

p_arm <- ggplot(arm_summary,
                aes(x = mean_cn_delta, y = mean_logFC, label = arm,
                    size = n_genes,
                    color = co_occurs)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
                  show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#D55E00", "FALSE" = "grey50"),
                     name = "CN-correlated",
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "shift co-occurs",
                                "FALSE" = "independent")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "Genes / arm") +
  labs(x = "Mean lpWGS CN delta (LOY − sgCTRL)",
       y = "Mean RNA logFC (LOY / sgCTRL)",
       title = "Chromosome-arm CN delta vs mean RNA logFC",
       subtitle = "Co-shifting arms suggest CN-driven RNA changes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
print(p_arm)
save_fig(p_arm, "chromosome_arm_CN_vs_RNA", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r y-loss-confirm, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=8}
# RNA: mean logCPM of chrY coding genes per sample (uses lcpm_par which
```

## 9.9 CN-flagged DEG sensitivity rerun (by design) {.tabset}

Re-run Hallmark fgsea and decoupleR TF activity with `cn_driven_flag == TRUE`
genes removed. Bumps in NES / TF scores that survive this filter are unlikely
to be driven by autosomal CN drift. Repeated across all three DE designs —
the CN flag set itself comes from the paired DE annotation in §9.4, but the
upstream rank vectors differ across designs, so the sensitivity question is
worth asking on each.

```{r cn-sens-helpers}
net_tri <- decoupleR::get_collectri(organism = "human",
                                    split_complexes = FALSE)

cn_sens_for <- function(de_design, cn_flag_genes, design_label) {
  ranks_full  <- prep_ranks(de_design)
  ranks_clean <- ranks_full[!names(ranks_full) %in% cn_flag_genes]

  set.seed(42)
  fg_full  <- suppressWarnings(
    fgsea(pathways_cam$hallmark, ranks_full, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500))
  set.seed(42)
  fg_clean <- suppressWarnings(
    fgsea(pathways_cam$hallmark, ranks_clean, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500))

  nes_cmp <- fg_full %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES_full = NES, padj_full = padj) %>%
    inner_join(fg_clean %>%
                 dplyr::select(pathway, NES_clean = NES,
                               padj_clean = padj),
               by = "pathway")
  rho_n <- cor(nes_cmp$NES_full, nes_cmp$NES_clean,
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

  deg_mat_full <- de_design %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(t), !is.na(gene_name),
                  !gene_name %in% par_gene_names) %>%   # drop PAR for TF
    distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, t) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    remove_rownames() %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
    as.matrix()
  deg_mat_clean <- deg_mat_full[!rownames(deg_mat_full) %in% cn_flag_genes,
                                , drop = FALSE]
  tf_full  <- decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = deg_mat_full,  net = net_tri,
                                 .source = "source", .target = "target",
                                 .mor = "mor", minsize = 5)
  tf_clean <- decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = deg_mat_clean, net = net_tri,
                                 .source = "source", .target = "target",
                                 .mor = "mor", minsize = 5)
  tf_cmp <- tf_full %>%
    dplyr::select(source, score_full = score, p_full = p_value) %>%
    inner_join(tf_clean %>%
                 dplyr::select(source, score_clean = score,
                               p_clean = p_value),
               by = "source")
  rho_t <- cor(tf_cmp$score_full, tf_cmp$score_clean,
               method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

  p_n <- ggplot(nes_cmp, aes(NES_full, NES_clean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_text_repel(data = nes_cmp %>%
                      dplyr::filter(abs(NES_full - NES_clean) > 0.5),
                    aes(label = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway)),
                    size = 2.7, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Hallmark NES (ρ = %.3f) · %s",
                         rho_n, design_label),
         x = "NES (all DEGs)", y = "NES (CN-flagged removed)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
  p_t <- ggplot(tf_cmp, aes(score_full, score_clean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_text_repel(data = tf_cmp %>%
                      dplyr::filter(abs(score_full - score_clean) > 1),
                    aes(label = source),
                    size = 2.7, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    labs(title = sprintf("TF activity (ULM) (ρ = %.3f) · %s",
                         rho_t, design_label),
         x = "Score (all DEGs)", y = "Score (CN-flagged removed)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)

  fwrite(nes_cmp,
         file.path(CN_DEG_DIR,
                   sprintf("ht1080_hallmark_NES_cn_sensitivity_%s.csv",
                           design_label)))
  fwrite(tf_cmp,
         file.path(CN_DEG_DIR,
                   sprintf("ht1080_TF_score_cn_sensitivity_%s.csv",
                           design_label)))

  list(nes_cmp = nes_cmp, tf_cmp = tf_cmp, p_n = p_n, p_t = p_t,
       rho_n = rho_n, rho_t = rho_t)
}

cn_flag_genes <- de_with_cn %>%
  dplyr::filter(cn_driven_flag) %>% pull(gene_name)
cat("Genes flagged CN-driven (anchor: paired DE annotation):",
    length(cn_flag_genes), "\n")
```

# 10. Robustness summary

Per-gene integration across the four statistical pipelines + CN flag +
paralog membership. "Confident DEG" = passes ≥ 3 of
{voom, voomQW, treat, edgeR-QL} at FDR<0.05 AND is not flagged CN-driven.

```{r robust-summary}
y_paralog_set <- c(paralog_pairs$Y, paralog_pairs$X)

robust <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, logFC, FDR_voom = FDR) %>%
  left_join(de_qw    %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, FDR_voomQW = FDR),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  left_join(de_treat %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, FDR_treat = FDR),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  left_join(de_ql    %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, FDR_edgeRQL = FDR),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  left_join(de_with_cn %>%
              dplyr::select(gene_name, cn_log2_LOY, cn_delta,
                            cn_driven_flag, cn_state_LOY),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  mutate(
    pass_voom    = !is.na(FDR_voom)    & FDR_voom    < ALPHA,
    pass_voomQW  = !is.na(FDR_voomQW)  & FDR_voomQW  < ALPHA,
    pass_treat   = !is.na(FDR_treat)   & FDR_treat   < ALPHA,
    pass_edgeRQL = !is.na(FDR_edgeRQL) & FDR_edgeRQL < ALPHA,
    n_pass = pass_voom + pass_voomQW + pass_treat + pass_edgeRQL,
    in_paralog_pair = gene_name %in% y_paralog_set,
    confident_DEG = n_pass >= 3 &
                    (is.na(cn_driven_flag) | !cn_driven_flag)
  ) %>%
  arrange(-n_pass, FDR_voom)

fwrite(robust,
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_robust.csv"))

cat(sprintf("Confident DEGs (≥3/4 frameworks, not CN-driven): %d\n",
            sum(robust$confident_DEG, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  up:   %d\n",
            sum(robust$confident_DEG & robust$logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  down: %d\n",
            sum(robust$confident_DEG & robust$logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Confident + in paralog pair: %d\n",
            sum(robust$confident_DEG & robust$in_paralog_pair,
                na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## 10.3 Over-representation analysis on confident DEGs

Hypergeometric test (`fgsea::fora`) — does the confident-DEG set (≥3/4
frameworks at FDR<0.05, not CN-driven) overlap pathways more than chance?
Up and down are tested separately against the same universe (all tested
genes in the working DE).

```{r robust-ora}
universe_genes <- robust %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(FDR_voom)) %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>% unique()

confident_up <- robust %>%
  dplyr::filter(confident_DEG, logFC > 0) %>% pull(gene_name) %>% unique()
confident_dn <- robust %>%
  dplyr::filter(confident_DEG, logFC < 0) %>% pull(gene_name) %>% unique()

cat(sprintf("Universe: %d genes\n", length(universe_genes)))
cat(sprintf("Confident up:   %d  | down: %d\n",
            length(confident_up), length(confident_dn)))

# Collections: Hallmark + CGP (chromatin/PRC2 hits live here) + Reactome
collections_ora <- list(
  hallmark = pathways_cam$hallmark,
  cgp      = pathways_cam$cgp,
  cp_reactome = pathways_cam$cp_react
)

run_fora_all <- function(gene_set, label) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(collections_ora), function(coll_name) {
    paths <- collections_ora[[coll_name]]
    fora_res <- suppressWarnings(
      fora(pathways = paths, genes = gene_set,
           universe = universe_genes, minSize = 10, maxSize = 500))
    fora_res %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(collection = coll_name, direction = label,
             # fora returns overlap (count); compute fold-enrichment
             expected = size * length(gene_set) / length(universe_genes),
             fold_enrichment = overlap / expected) %>%
      arrange(padj)
  }))
}

ora_up <- run_fora_all(confident_up, "Up in LOY")
ora_dn <- run_fora_all(confident_dn, "Down in LOY")
ora_all <- bind_rows(ora_up, ora_dn)

fwrite(ora_all %>%
         dplyr::select(direction, collection, pathway, pval, padj,
                       overlap, size, expected, fold_enrichment,
                       overlapGenes) %>%
         mutate(overlapGenes = sapply(overlapGenes, paste, collapse = ";")),
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_robustDEG_ORA.csv"))

cat("\n=== Top 15 Hallmark over-represented in Up-confident DEGs ===\n")
ora_up %>% dplyr::filter(collection == "hallmark") %>%
  slice_min(padj, n = 15) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, overlap, size, fold_enrichment, padj) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 4))

cat("\n=== Top 15 Hallmark over-represented in Down-confident DEGs ===\n")
ora_dn %>% dplyr::filter(collection == "hallmark") %>%
  slice_min(padj, n = 15) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, overlap, size, fold_enrichment, padj) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 4))
```

### Hallmark + Reactome dotplot

```{r robust-ora-dotplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
plot_df <- ora_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(collection %in% c("hallmark", "cp_reactome"),
                padj < 0.1) %>%
  group_by(direction, collection) %>%
  slice_min(padj, n = 12) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_|^REACTOME_", "", pathway) %>%
                      gsub("_", " ", .) %>%

    pathway_label = paste0("[", substr(collection, 1, 4), "] ",

  )

if (nrow(plot_df) > 0) {
  p_ora_dot <- ggplot(plot_df,
                      aes(x = fold_enrichment, y = pathway_label,
                          size = overlap, fill = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                        name = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "DEG overlap") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Fold enrichment (overlap / expected)", y = NULL,
         title = "ORA on confident DEGs — Hallmark + Reactome",
         subtitle = paste(
           "Hypergeometric test (fgsea::fora);",
           "universe = all tested genes")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
  print(p_ora_dot)
  save_fig(p_ora_dot, "robust_DEG_ORA_dotplot",
           width = 8, height = 8)
} else {
  cat("No pathways at padj<0.1 in Hallmark/Reactome ORA.\n")
}
```
