## 10.4 Cross-design × cross-framework panel

The §10.1–§10.3 summary above is anchored on the **paired** design (the
analysis of record). This sub-section asks the broader question: across all
three designs × {voom, treat, edgeR-QL}, how many of the 9 (design ×
framework) cells does each gene reach FDR<0.05? Genes flagged in ≥6/9 cells
AND not CN-driven are the most robust LOY-driven candidates.

```{r robust-cross-design}
build_design_fdr <- function(top_df, design_label, framework) {
  top_df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
    distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    setNames(c("gene_name",
               sprintf("FDR_%s_%s", framework, design_label)))
}

fdr_tables <- list(
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$paired$fit_obj$top,   "paired",   "voom"),
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$unpaired$fit_obj$top, "unpaired", "voom"),
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$pooled$fit_obj$top,   "pooled",   "voom"),
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$paired$top,           "paired",   "treat"),
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$unpaired$top,         "unpaired", "treat"),
  build_design_fdr(treat_results$pooled$top,           "pooled",   "treat"),
  build_design_fdr(ql_results$paired$top,              "paired",   "edgeRQL"),
  build_design_fdr(ql_results$unpaired$top,            "unpaired", "edgeRQL"),
  build_design_fdr(ql_results$pooled$top,              "pooled",   "edgeRQL"))

wide_fdr <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "gene_name"),
                   fdr_tables)
fdr_cols <- setdiff(names(wide_fdr), "gene_name")

wide_fdr <- wide_fdr %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_pass9 = sum(c_across(all_of(fdr_cols)) < ALPHA, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(de_with_cn %>% dplyr::select(gene_name, cn_driven_flag),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  left_join(treat_results$paired$fit_obj$top %>%
              dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  arrange(-n_pass9)

wide_fdr <- wide_fdr %>%
  mutate(in_paralog_pair = gene_name %in% y_paralog_set,
         confident_DEG9  = n_pass9 >= 6 &
                           (is.na(cn_driven_flag) | !cn_driven_flag))

fwrite(wide_fdr,
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_robust_cross_design.csv"))

cat(sprintf("\nCross-design × cross-framework confident DEGs (>=6/9 cells, not CN-driven): %d\n",
            sum(wide_fdr$confident_DEG9, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  up:   %d   down: %d\n",
            sum(wide_fdr$confident_DEG9 & wide_fdr$logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(wide_fdr$confident_DEG9 & wide_fdr$logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

agreement9 <- wide_fdr %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(logFC)) %>%
  count(n_pass9, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(label = paste(n_pass9, "of 9"))

p_agree9 <- ggplot(agreement9,
                   aes(x = factor(n_pass9), y = n,
                       fill = factor(n_pass9))) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Cells passing FDR<0.05 (voom/treat/edgeRQL × paired/unpaired/pooled)",
       y = "Gene count",
       title = "Cross-design × cross-framework DEG agreement (9 cells)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
print(p_agree9)
save_fig(p_agree9, "robust_cross_design_agreement",
         width = 9, height = 4)
```

```{r robust-cross-design-top}
  dplyr::filter(confident_DEG9) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC, n_pass9,
                in_paralog_pair, cn_driven_flag,
                FDR_voom_paired, FDR_treat_paired, FDR_edgeRQL_paired,
                FDR_voom_unpaired, FDR_treat_unpaired, FDR_edgeRQL_unpaired,
                FDR_voom_pooled,   FDR_treat_pooled,   FDR_edgeRQL_pooled) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 2, 0, 0, 0,
```

# 11. LOY transcriptomics summary table

A consolidated per-gene table of the LOY-vs-sgCTRL effect with per-sample
expression. Covers:

- Every **expressed chromosome-Y gene** (post-filter), classified by genomic
  region as PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY (male-specific Y)
- **PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY signature** rows — mean logCPM across each region per
  sample, paired-LM test (treatment + passage) on the resulting scores
- **Top-20 up + top-20 down** DEGs from the paired LOY-vs-sgCTRL contrast
  (FDR<ALPHA, |logFC|>LFC_THR, non-chrY)
- **Genes of interest**: DCC, XIST, and the X-paralogs of each Y gene
  tracked in §7

Per-sample columns are logCPM (matching how the rest of the report
visualises expression). Full CSV (both CPM and logCPM aggregates, per-sample
logCPM) lands at
`HT1080/DE_extended/ht1080_LOY_transcriptomics_summary.csv`.

## 11.1 PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY / Yp / Yq gene panel

The classifier reuses the PAR coordinate constants defined in §1.4.5
(`PAR1_X_START` etc., `Y_CENTROMERE_MID`). The §11 panel is built from
`dge_full_no_yfilter$genes` so the per-sample expression matrix built in
§11.2 has matching dimensions — that's a tighter gene set than §1.4.5's
`y_panel` (which uses the unfiltered `dge0`).

```{r y-summary-classify}
# Use the constants from §1.4.5; chrY PAR-coord exclusion via PAR1_Y_END/
# PAR2_Y_START is defensive (EnsDb has 0 chrY entries in PAR coords, but
# keeps the filter symmetric).
PAR1_Y_END   <- PAR1_X_END        # PAR1 spans identical on chrX and chrY
PAR2_Y_START <- 56887903L         # chrY PAR2 start (different from chrX)

par1_genes <- dge_full_no_yfilter$genes %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "X",
                start >= PAR1_X_START, end <= PAR1_X_END) %>%
  mutate(region = "PAR1", arm = "Yp")
par2_genes <- dge_full_no_yfilter$genes %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "X",
                start >= PAR2_X_START, end <= PAR2_X_END) %>%
  mutate(region = "PAR2", arm = "Yq")
msy_genes <- dge_full_no_yfilter$genes %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(seqnames == "Y",
                !(end <= PAR1_Y_END | start >= PAR2_Y_START)) %>%
  mutate(region = "MSY",
         arm    = ifelse(end <= Y_CENTROMERE_MID, "Yp", "Yq"))

y_genes <- bind_rows(par1_genes, par2_genes, msy_genes)

cat(sprintf(
  "Expressed Y-related genes: %d  [PAR1=%d, PAR2=%d, MSY=%d (MSY-Yp=%d, MSY-Yq=%d)]\n",
  nrow(y_genes),
  nrow(par1_genes), nrow(par2_genes), nrow(msy_genes),
  sum(msy_genes$arm == "Yp"),
  sum(msy_genes$arm == "Yq")))
```

## 11.2 Per-sample expression helper

```{r y-summary-matrices}
# logCPM + CPM on the Y-retaining DGEList from §7. Helper takes a vector of
# ensembl_ids and returns a tibble with per-gene group means (CTRL/LOY) for
# both CPM and logCPM, plus one column per sample of logCPM.
lcpm_full <- cpm(dge_full_no_yfilter, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
cpm_full  <- cpm(dge_full_no_yfilter, log = FALSE)

samples_y <- dge_full_no_yfilter$samples %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, treatment, passage)

expr_row_for <- function(gene_ids) {
  # Build an empty 0-row tibble with the full column structure intact, so
  # downstream inner_join + select on the result works even when no genes
  # match (relevant for A549, whose paired LOY-vs-sgCTRL contrast yields 0
  # DEGs at FDR<0.05 & |logFC|>0.75).
  empty_per_sample <- as_tibble(setNames(
    replicate(ncol(lcpm_full), numeric(0), simplify = FALSE),
    paste0("logCPM_", colnames(lcpm_full))))
  empty_out <- bind_cols(
    tibble(
      ensembl_id       = character(0),
      mean_CTRL_logCPM = numeric(0),
      mean_LOY_logCPM  = numeric(0),
      mean_CTRL_CPM    = numeric(0),
      mean_LOY_CPM     = numeric(0)),
    empty_per_sample)

  ids_in <- intersect(gene_ids, rownames(lcpm_full))
  if (length(ids_in) == 0) return(empty_out)
  lc <- lcpm_full[ids_in, , drop = FALSE]
  cp <- cpm_full [ids_in, , drop = FALSE]
  ctrl_idx <- which(samples_y$treatment == "CTRL")
  loy_idx  <- which(samples_y$treatment == "LOY")
  per_sample_lc <- as.data.frame(lc)
  colnames(per_sample_lc) <- paste0("logCPM_", colnames(lc))
  tibble(
    ensembl_id       = rownames(lc),
    mean_CTRL_logCPM = rowMeans(lc[, ctrl_idx, drop = FALSE]),
    mean_LOY_logCPM  = rowMeans(lc[, loy_idx,  drop = FALSE]),
    mean_CTRL_CPM    = rowMeans(cp[, ctrl_idx, drop = FALSE]),
    mean_LOY_CPM     = rowMeans(cp[, loy_idx,  drop = FALSE])
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(per_sample_lc)
}
```

## 11.3 chrY gene table

```{r y-summary-chry-table}
chry_expr  <- expr_row_for(y_genes$ensembl_id)
chry_block <- y_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_id, gene_name, region, arm) %>%
  inner_join(chry_expr, by = "ensembl_id") %>%

              dplyr::select(ensembl_id, logFC, PValue, FDR),
            by = "ensembl_id") %>%

  arrange(region, FDR)

chry_block %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, region, arm, logFC, FDR,
                mean_CTRL_logCPM, mean_LOY_logCPM,
                mean_CTRL_CPM, mean_LOY_CPM) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1),
               caption = "PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY genes — paired DE + group-mean expression")
```

## 11.4 PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY signature scores

```{r y-summary-signatures}
# Signature score = mean logCPM across genes in the region per sample.
# Paired LM (treatment + passage) tests whether the per-sample mean shifts
# with LOY, holding passage constant.
build_sig_row <- function(genes_in, sig_name) {
  ids_in <- intersect(genes_in, rownames(lcpm_full))
  if (length(ids_in) < 2) return(NULL)
  scores <- colMeans(lcpm_full[ids_in, , drop = FALSE])
  df <- samples_y %>% mutate(score = scores[sample])
  f <- tryCatch(lm(score ~ treatment + passage, data = df),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  beta <- NA_real_; pval <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(f)) {
    co <- summary(f)$coefficients
    loy_row <- grep("treatmentLOY", rownames(co), value = TRUE)
    if (length(loy_row) > 0) {
      beta <- co[loy_row, "Estimate"]
      pval <- co[loy_row, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    }
  }
  ctrl_idx <- which(samples_y$treatment == "CTRL")
  loy_idx  <- which(samples_y$treatment == "LOY")
  base_row <- tibble(
    gene_name        = sig_name,
    ensembl_id       = NA_character_,
    region           = sub("_signature$", "", sig_name),
    category         = "signature",
    n_genes          = length(ids_in),
    mean_CTRL_logCPM = mean(scores[ctrl_idx]),
    mean_LOY_logCPM  = mean(scores[loy_idx]),
    mean_CTRL_CPM    = NA_real_,
    mean_LOY_CPM     = NA_real_,
    logFC            = beta,
    PValue           = pval)
  per_sample <- as.data.frame(t(scores))
  colnames(per_sample) <- paste0("logCPM_", colnames(per_sample))
  bind_cols(base_row, per_sample)
}

sig_rows <- bind_rows(
  build_sig_row(y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "PAR1"], "PAR1_signature"),
  build_sig_row(y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "PAR2"], "PAR2_signature"),
  build_sig_row(y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "MSY"],  "MSY_signature"),
  build_sig_row(y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$arm    == "Yp"],   "Yp_signature"),
  build_sig_row(y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$arm    == "Yq"],   "Yq_signature")) %>%
  mutate(arm = recode(gene_name,
                      PAR1_signature = "Yp",
                      PAR2_signature = "Yq",
                      MSY_signature  = NA_character_,
                      Yp_signature   = "Yp",
                      Yq_signature   = "Yq"))
sig_rows$FDR <- p.adjust(sig_rows$PValue, method = "BH")

sig_rows %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, n_genes, logFC, PValue, FDR,
                mean_CTRL_logCPM, mean_LOY_logCPM) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 3, 4, 4, 2, 2),
               caption = "Y-region signatures: PAR1, PAR2, MSY + Yp/Yq arm aggregates (mean region logCPM per sample, paired LM)")
```

## 11.4b Per-sample PAR / MSY signature scores

Compact sample-by-region table — the raw per-sample data that feeds the
paired-LM tests in §11.4. Each cell is the mean logCPM across the genes in
that region for that sample. Useful for spotting per-sample outliers or
incomplete LOY (e.g. a "LOY" sample whose MSY mean hasn't fully collapsed)
before reading the summary statistics. Restricted to the LOY-vs-sgCTRL
working set (PARENTAL not included; see §1 for the rationale).

```{r y-summary-per-sample}
sample_region_specs <- list(
  PAR1 = y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "PAR1"],
  PAR2 = y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "PAR2"],
  MSY  = y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$region == "MSY"],
  Yp   = y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$arm    == "Yp"],
  Yq   = y_genes$ensembl_id[y_genes$arm    == "Yq"])

sample_region_mat <- vapply(sample_region_specs, function(ids) {
  ids_in <- intersect(ids, rownames(lcpm_full))
  if (length(ids_in) < 1) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(lcpm_full)))
  colMeans(lcpm_full[ids_in, , drop = FALSE])
}, FUN.VALUE = numeric(ncol(lcpm_full)))
rownames(sample_region_mat) <- colnames(lcpm_full)

sample_region_tbl <- samples_y %>%
  cbind(as.data.frame(sample_region_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(treatment, passage)

sample_region_tbl %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2),
               caption = "Per-sample Y-region mean logCPM (PAR1 / PAR2 / MSY / Yp / Yq)")

fwrite(sample_region_tbl,
       file.path(DE_DIR, "ht1080_LOY_sample_level_PAR_MSY.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Wrote %d-row sample-level PAR/MSY table to ht1080_LOY_sample_level_PAR_MSY.csv\n",
            nrow(sample_region_tbl)))
```

## 11.5 Top up + top down DEGs (non-chrY)

```{r y-summary-top-degs}
top_n_each <- 20L
top_up <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC >  LFC_THR) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = top_n_each) %>%
  mutate(category = "top_up")
top_dn <- de_loy_ctrl %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, logFC < -LFC_THR) %>%
  slice_min(FDR, n = top_n_each) %>%
  mutate(category = "top_down")

top_expr  <- expr_row_for(c(top_up$ensembl_id, top_dn$ensembl_id))
top_block <- bind_rows(top_up, top_dn) %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_id, gene_name, category, logFC, PValue, FDR) %>%
  inner_join(top_expr, by = "ensembl_id") %>%
  mutate(region = "non-Y") %>%
  arrange(category, FDR)

top_block %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, category, logFC, FDR,
                mean_CTRL_logCPM, mean_LOY_logCPM) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 2, 4, 2, 2),
               caption = sprintf(
                 "Top %d up + Top %d down DEGs (paired, FDR<%.2g, |logFC|>%.2g, non-chrY)",
                 top_n_each, top_n_each, ALPHA, LFC_THR))
```

```{r y-summary-goi}
goi_genes <- unique(c(
```
